day_shape: 81 items: OFAC publishes Iran-related General Licences AA and BB, CENTCOM reports 75 vessels redirected under the Iran blockade, IDF strikes Hezbollah sites in Nabatieh after two drones at troops, and Rezaei threatens to 'send Netanyahu to hell'; nothing from UK Parliament.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade and sanctions
threads.summary: OFAC published Iran-related General Licences AA and BB, and CENTCOM said it had redirected 75 commercial vessels, disabled three and boarded two enforcing the blockade. Trump said the US had cleared the strait of mines, while Iran International reported three regional mediators visited Tehran in three days.

threads.label: Rezaei and Araghchi escalate rhetoric
threads.summary: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei told Al-Manar Iran would 'send Netanyahu to hell' and threatened 100% targeting of US economic interests, claiming 80 million barrels exported during the ceasefire. Foreign Minister Araghchi wrote to Guterres demanding the US halt 'economic terrorism', a letter Dujarric confirmed was circulated to the Security Council.

threads.label: IDF strikes in southern Lebanon after drones
threads.summary: The IDF said Hezbollah launched two explosive drones overnight at troops on the Ali-Taher Ridge inside the Security Zone, with one downed and no injuries. Israel then struck Hezbollah weapons storage sites in the Nabatieh area, with IRIB also reporting strikes on al-Mansouri and Barashit.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and ceasefire disputes
threads.summary: The IDF announced strikes killing Hamas commanders Bilal Ibrahim Saleh Raqi'i in Shati and Azzam Rifaat Abd Abadala and Ismail Barim in Khan Younis, plus two Nukhba operatives from the October 7 attack. Netanyahu and Katz said there was 'no instruction' to open Erez Crossing, while COGAT told the Post preparations for a Sept. 1 opening await approval.

threads.label: Coordination centre and UNRWA dispute
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Israel is considering expelling British and possibly other European officials from the US-led post-war Gaza coordination centre in Kiryat Gat, though an Israeli official denied a parallel report about German and Italian representatives. The State Department recommended disbarring three former UNRWA staff over alleged Hamas and PIJ ties.

threads.label: SDF dissolution into Syrian state
threads.summary: UK Deputy Permanent Representative Kate Foster welcomed the announced dissolution of the Syrian Democratic Forces into central government structures at the UN Security Council. IRIB reported Mazlum Abdi is to become an adviser to the Syrian president, and Jerusalem Post carried regional reactions to the integration.

threads.label: Iran plot allegations and domestic repression
threads.summary: Rezaei denied reports of a plot to assassinate Barron Trump after the Secret Service cited an Iranian state TV video, while Times of Israel reported Newsmax's claim that Yair Netanyahu was targeted in Florida. Iran International reported Leila Abolhassani was sentenced to death for 'waging war against God' and detailed rising seizures against Bahá'ís described by a UN representative as 'state-sponsored theft'.

The strikes were "carried out to remove the threat," the army adds.
